Pretty much everything you do in the game requires you to pay. Otherwise, all you can do is sit around and wait. I honestly couldn’t figure out what the game’s ultimate goal is, or even what meaningful short-term goals there are. Unless you spend a huge amount of money, there’s simply no sense of achievement to be gained from this game.

content: This game is nothing like the ads, which make it seem like a tower defense game.  This is that same game as Last War or Age of Empires Mobile or like hundreds of other games. title: Excellent Strategy Game!
content:
I downloaded Kingshot thinking it was like the ads that you play for a few seconds on other games or videos. That’s about 0.01% of the actual game! City building, alliance coordination, events, troop compositions, stats, damage equations…it’s unreal how complex this game is for a mobile app! You start in the newest Kingdom (I’m in 2282) with others that are similar level to you. So you never feel far behind and you level up with the people you meet on day one. There are going to be people that spend thousands upon thousands of dollars (whales) so there’ll always be someone stronger than you. But that makes it competitive and motivating to see where you will end up eventually. I recommend you start a new character from scratch and don’t purchase one you can find on Reddit or other sources. It’s very risky and kills the whole point of leveling and growing from nothing into an absolute beast at higher levels.

This game is F2P, but if you spend, it becomes an absolute blast to watch your city go from low levels to reaching big power. There’s always something to do and new events to attend. You’re rarely just sitting idle wondering what to do next. I’ve met some of the coolest people I’ve ever met in games through my alliance. The teamwork needed in this game is second to none. You are no one alone. I’ve only been playing for a month and a half and I’m just getting started. Highly recommend this game for all ages and make sure you have Apple Pay setup before downloading! :)
